title: Each with ulterior motives
next_chapter_hook: As various forces were passing the blame to each other, a cold voice suddenly sounded behind Chen Ji: 'Nice acting, but this script you're performing has no role for me.'

text.content: Vines on the cliff wall rustled in the night wind as Chen Ji gripped a protruding rock with one hand, dangling over the abyss below. He looked up at the cliff top where the wild laughter echoed through the night sky. Han Lie, laugh all you want. When you're done laughing, you'll realize that what you destroyed with your own hands is worth far more than you imagined.

dialogue.content: Hahaha! Atrash is still atrash, dares to put on a deep act before me? Good riddance! Sect Leader Ling, you see this? This is what happens when you offend our Xuanwu Sect!

text.content: Atop the cliff, firelight illuminated dozens of faces with varied expressions. Ling Yuan's expression was so gloomy it seemed to drip with water, his eyes fixed intently on Han Lie's back, the killing intent in his gaze almost crystallizing into substance. Further away, several officials in imperial robes were whispering among themselves, the leader frowning deeply, clearly very dissatisfied with what he saw.

dialogue.content: Han Lie! How bold of you! Who gave you permission to act on your own? There's something we need on thistrash, and now that he's dead, what can you use to fill this gap?!

Oh? Is that how Sect Leader Ling speaks? As if the person's death was my fault? It seems the old man wants to shift the blame. Weren't you the one who swore thistrash had secrets when he emerged from the Tianqing Sect? Now that he's gone, you blame me?

text.content: Chen Ji hung on the cliff wall, a smile curling at his lips. Han Lie, Han Lie, you think you're showing off your power? Little do you know, every wild word you speak is driving the nail I'm burying deeper into the ground. Once that old fox Ling Yuan's suspicions take root, they're not so easily removed.

dialogue.content: (The imperial envoy stepped forward, his gaze sharp as a blade) I would like to ask, what happened to the plan you three parties agreed upon beforehand? You said no one would act for three days, waiting for the imperial officials to arrive for unified action. But what happened? The Demonic Path struck early, the person is dead, and now you three are blaming each other. This farce—is this what you want me to report back to His Majesty? That your three major sects together can't even handle onetrash disciple?

text.content: At these words, a strange silence fell over the cliff top. Chen Ji listened clearly from below and couldn't help but give this envoy a mental thumbs up. Clever, this single sentence directly roasted all three parties. Ling Yuan wanted to shift blame to Han Lie, Han Lie wanted to clear his name, and now—their common goal became covering up their own incompetence.

choice.prompt: The dog-eat-dog fight atop the cliff was in full swing, and Chen Ji needed to decide his next move—whether to continue watching the show as their internal strife intensified, or take advantage of the chaos to climb up and add fuel to the fire.

choices.description: Continue hanging on the cliff wall, eavesdropping, letting the contradictions among all parties ferment on their own, waiting for the optimal moment to act.
choices.visible_reward: Gather more intelligence, understand the bottom lines of all parties

text.content: Chen Ji adjusted his position, hanging more steadily while holding his breath and continuing to catch every word drifting from the cliff top. The more chaotic the situation, the more patience was needed. He wanted to see firsthand how these self-important big shots could debase themselves.

choices.description: Take advantage of the chaos to climb up the cliff, and without exposing himself, use minor tactics to deepen the contradictions between them.
choices.visible_reward: Foresight Han Lie's next move in advance

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes. Since he was already "dead," he might as well die more completely. He quietly activated the Tianji Record, and a blurry image flashed through his mind—In twenty-five minutes, Han Lie would fly into a rage due to Ling Yuan's questioning and say things he shouldn't in public.

dialogue.content: (Coldly snorting) The envoy speaks wisely; this was indeed Ling's lack of foresight. However, if our Xuanwu Sect's genius hadn't been so eager to claim credit, the situation wouldn't have come to this. When thattrash fell from the cliff, I clearly saw something clutched in his hand—that thing is probably now none of Young Master Han's concern.
(Face turning ashen) Ling, what do you mean?! Are you saying I embezzled thattrash's belongings? Han Lie, the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect, would covet some rubbish from a servant disciple?!

text.content: Chen Ji below the cliff nearly burst out laughing. This old fox Ling Yuan was indeed trouble. He said nothing, just casually tossed out a "looted goods suspicion" and directly put Han Lie on the hot seat. The imperial envoy hated nothing more than subordinates secretly hoarding benefits—now Han Lie had no way to defend himself.

dialogue.content: (The imperial envoy narrowed his eyes) Oh? So Sect Leader Ling means thattrash had something the dynasty needs, and Young Master Han privately took it? Han genius, you better give this official an explanation, otherwise—after returning, this memorial won't be easy to write.

text.content: The situation was developing exactly as Chen Ji had预设. The three factions suspecting, accusing, and blaming each other—this was precisely the effect he wanted. But Chen Ji knew it wasn't enough. That old fox Ling Yuan wouldn't be easily provoked; he must have a deeper purpose. Chen Ji had to stay alert and prevent the situation from spiraling out of control.

choice.prompt: Seeing the three parties about to break into open conflict, should Chen Ji add more fuel to expose Ling Yuan's true intentions?

choices.text: Lure the snake out of its hole
choices.description: Deliberately make some noise, letting Ling Yuan discover the "dead man" is still alive, thereby forcing him to reveal more cards.
choices.visible_reward: Make Ling Yuan show his true colors

text.content: Chen Ji took out a small stone and lightly flicked it toward the other side of the cliff wall above. The stone struck the rock with a crisp sound—everyone present was a master, and this small disturbance was enough to draw attention. Ling Yuan's gaze immediately swept over, and Chen Ji could clearly see the suspicion and greed flickering in those eyes.

choices.description: Suppress the impulse, continue as an audience, wait for the three parties to completely break ranks before acting.

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his gaze and continued hiding in the shadows. It wasn't time to act yet. Ling Yuan was extremely scheming—if he acted rashly, he might alert the target. Better to let them keep arguing, wait for the imperial envoy to lose patience with Han Lie, wait for Han Lie to completely despair of Ling Yuan—then cast the net, with better odds of success.

choices.description: Quietly climb up the cliff in the chaos, make some moves in an unnoticeable corner, laying groundwork for the next layout.

text.content: Chen Ji climbed silently upward, taking advantage of the cliff top crowd's attention being focused on the argument. His figure moved through the darkness like a nimble cat. Soon, he had circled to a depression in the cliff wall on the side, perfectly positioned to hear everyone's conversation while hidden in the shadows.

dialogue.content: (Trembling with rage) Good! Good indeed, Ling Yuan! You say I embezzled thattrash's loot, then what about you? Why would a Tianqing Sect servant disciple have something even the dynasty wants? In the end, you're the most suspicious one! Envoy, I demand a thorough investigation of Ling Yuan!

(Eyes turning cold) Han Lie, you'd better think carefully about what you're saying. Tianqing Sect affairs are not for outsiders to meddle in. Today's matter will be reported to the sect. As for you—publicly slandering this sect leader before the imperial envoy, this debt is记账.

text.content: Chen Ji listened to this exchange and secretly applauded. Han Lie truly didn't disappoint him; this wild accusation directly brought the fire to Ling Yuan. But Chen Ji also noticed Ling Yuan's reaction was too calm—this old fox had been dealt a silent blow by the imperial envoy yet didn't even furrow his brow. Either he was of immeasurable depth, or—he had other hidden cards.

choice.prompt: The situation growing ever more chaotic, Chen Ji needed to decide—whether to continue observing, or take advantage of the moment to do something?

choices.description: Pretend to be injured but not dead,发出求救声, guiding the three factions to slaughter each other.
choices.visible_reward: The three parties descend into complete chaos

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and was about to speak when he suddenly sensed an unusual fluctuation behind him. It was an extremely familiar aura—one from the same source as the Tianji Record. He abruptly turned, his pupils contracting sharply. A blurry figure floated behind him, its features indiscernible in the night, but those eyes—deep, ancient, carrying theindifferentof one who sees through worldly affairs.

choices.description: Stay silent, continue observing, see exactly what game Ling Yuan is playing.
choices.risk_hint: Risk being discovered by a third party

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the impulse in his heart and decided to wait a bit longer. Just then, a voice suddenly sounded behind him, clear as if right at his ear: 'Silly boy, what are you still standing there for?' The voice was aged and gentle, carrying a teasing tone. Chen Ji's blood instantly froze—this voice, he had heard it countless times in the Tianji Record, but never imagined it would appear in such circumstances.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's form flickering in the moonlight, a meaningful smile playing at his lips) Nice acting, lad. But—this play you're putting on, the script doesn't include me. So, old man is here to add some spice.

text.content: Before Mo Xiansheng even finished speaking, a deafening roar suddenly echoed from the cliff top! Chen Ji looked up sharply to see Ling Yuan had somehow struck, a fierce sword energy directly aimed at Han Lie's face! And the imperial envoy, startled by this sudden turn of events, stumbled backward, shouting angrily: 'Are you mad! Striking before this official?!' Chen Ji was dumbfounded—this script seems a bit off? Mo Xiansheng merely smiled, floating like an immortal.
